zhTitle: 课程导论
enTitle: Course Introduction
coreQuestion: How can a natural-language question about the brain be converted into a closed loop linking variables, models, computable predictions, and testable data?

zhTitle: 向量、矩阵与概率基础
enTitle: Vectors, Matrices, and Probability
coreQuestion: How can shape reasoning guarantee that a linear-algebra operation is defined, and how can probability distributions turn uncertainty in neural data into a computable object?

zhTitle: 微分方程与 Euler 数值模拟
enTitle: Differential Equations and Euler Simulation
coreQuestion: How can an instantaneous law of state change be turned into a time trajectory, and how can Euler's method approximate it safely when no analytic solution is available?

zhTitle: 神经元 I：膜电位、电路与 Integrate-and-Fire
enTitle: Neurons I: Membrane Voltage, Circuits, and Integrate-and-Fire
coreQuestion: How can ion diffusion, electric fields, and membrane structure be mapped to a circuit, and how does charge conservation produce integrate-and-fire dynamics?

zhTitle: 神经元 II：LIF 解析解与 Hodgkin–Huxley
enTitle: Neurons II: LIF Solution and Hodgkin–Huxley
coreQuestion: How does exponential charging in an LIF neuron determine threshold crossing and its F-I curve, and how does the Hodgkin–Huxley model generate a real spike through dynamic conductances?

zhTitle: 神经编码 I：Poisson 脉冲与最大似然
enTitle: Neural Coding I: Poisson Spikes and Maximum Likelihood
coreQuestion: How can trial-to-trial spike variability be expressed as a Poisson encoding model, and how can a stimulus be decoded from the population likelihood?

zhTitle: 神经编码 II：群体解码、Fisher 信息与 Bayesian 解码
enTitle: Neural Coding II: Population Decoding, Fisher Information, and Bayes
coreQuestion: How does the Fisher information of a population code grow with neuron count and observation time, and how do correlated noise, bias, and a prior alter decodable precision?

zhTitle: 神经网络 I：脉冲表示、卷积与 E/I 平衡
enTitle: Neural Networks I: Spikes, Convolution, and E/I Balance
coreQuestion: How are discrete spike times converted into synaptic currents, and how do the mean, variance, and E/I balance scale differently in a large network?

zhTitle: 神经网络 II：突触动力学与 firing-rate 模型
enTitle: Neural Networks II: Synaptic Dynamics and Rate Models
coreQuestion: How is a linear system's exponential memory equivalent to a synaptic ODE, and how does timescale separation turn a spiking network into a firing-rate model?

zhTitle: 突触可塑性
enTitle: Synaptic Plasticity
coreQuestion: How does Hebbian plasticity alter a synapse through spike timing and receptor mechanisms, and how can its firing-rate and matrix descriptions select statistical input structure without runaway weight growth?

zhTitle: 机器学习：回归、梯度下降与反向传播
enTitle: Machine Learning: Regression, Gradient Descent, and Backpropagation
coreQuestion: How do architecture, loss, and a gradient-based learning rule define supervised learning, and how does the chain rule train a multilayer network efficiently?

zhTitle: 视觉导论：层级、感受野与 LNP 模型
enTitle: Introduction to Vision: Hierarchy, Receptive Fields, and LNP Models
coreQuestion: How does the visual system use linear filters, nonlinearities, and hierarchical feature maps to turn luminance patterns into selectivity for position, orientation, and motion?

zhTitle: 脉冲触发平均与白噪声系统辨识
enTitle: Spike-Triggered Average and White-Noise System Identification
coreQuestion: Under white-noise stimulation, why can the spike-triggered average estimate an LNP linear filter, and under which conditions can it fail fundamentally?

zhTitle: Spike-Triggered Covariance 与广义线性模型
enTitle: Spike-Triggered Covariance and Generalized Linear Models
coreQuestion: When one linear feature is insufficient, how does STC reveal a multidimensional stimulus subspace, and how do GLMs unify Gaussian, Poisson, and Bernoulli response models?

zhTitle: 高效编码与信息论
enTitle: Efficient Coding and Information Theory
coreQuestion: How does the efficient-coding hypothesis formalize redundancy reduction with entropy, mutual information, and a noisy linear channel, and how can it predict retinal center-surround filters?

zhTitle: 适应、自然场景统计与 Fourier 分析
enTitle: Adaptation, Natural Scene Statistics, and Fourier Analysis
coreQuestion: How is the correlation structure of natural images represented in the Fourier domain, and how does SNR let an efficient retinal filter adapt between decorrelation and denoising?

zhTitle: 视觉网络：级联、复杂细胞与循环动力学
enTitle: Visual Networks: Cascades, Complex Cells, and Recurrence
coreQuestion: How do multilayer LNP cascades and a quadratic energy model produce selectivity and invariance, and how can recurrent E/I dynamics explain surround suppression?

zhTitle: 运动系统与线性神经动力学
enTitle: Motor Systems and Linear Neural Dynamics
coreQuestion: How can a distributed motor population be written as a linear recurrent dynamical system, and how do eigenmodes distinguish decay, long memory, perfect integration, and instability?

zhTitle: 群体活动与主成分分析
enTitle: Population Activity and Principal Component Analysis
coreQuestion: How do recurrent modes in a two-neuron network produce nearly one-dimensional population trajectories, and how does PCA recover maximum-variance dimensions from activity covariance alone?

zhTitle: 中央模式发生器与振荡
enTitle: Central Pattern Generators and Oscillations
coreQuestion: Is the rhythm cell-intrinsic or network-generated, and how do linear complex modes, Morris–Lecar fast–slow geometry, and half-center inhibition each produce oscillatory behavior?

zhTitle: 眼动积分器、参数退化与 sloppy models
enTitle: Oculomotor Integrator, Degeneracy, and Sloppy Models
coreQuestion: How does a recurrent network integrate an eye-velocity command into persistent position, why can many parameter combinations implement the same function, and how does the Hessian reveal stiff and sloppy directions?

zhTitle: 运动皮层潜在动力学与脑机接口
enTitle: Motor Cortex Latent Dynamics and Brain–Machine Interfaces
coreQuestion: How are high-dimensional motor-cortex activities organized by a few latent trajectories, how can preparatory activity occupy output-null space, and how can these ideas support a stable closed-loop BMI?

zhTitle: 短时记忆与知觉决策
enTitle: Short-Term Memory and Perceptual Decisions
coreQuestion: How do long-time-scale recurrent modes, evidence accumulation, and nonlinear attractor dynamics implement short-term memory and perceptual decision-making, and how do those mechanisms relate to behavior?

zhTitle: 从奖励中学习
enTitle: Learning from Rewards
coreQuestion: How does reward-gated plasticity avoid unconditional weight growth and produce matching, and how do value prediction and temporal-difference error explain blocking and dopamine responses?

zhTitle: 强化学习：MDP、Bellman 方程与 Q-learning
enTitle: Reinforcement Learning: MDPs, Bellman Equations, and Q-Learning
coreQuestion: How can an MDP formalize agent–environment interaction, how does recursively decomposing discounted return yield the Bellman equation, and how do Q-learning and a generative model learn an action policy?

zhTitle: Hopfield 联想记忆模型
enTitle: Hopfield Associative Memory
coreQuestion: How do symmetric Hebbian recurrent weights turn random binary patterns into attractors, and how do energy descent, crosstalk noise, and loading \(\alpha\) determine pattern completion and capacity?

zhTitle: 系统巩固与泛化
enTitle: Systems Consolidation and Generalization
coreQuestion: How does episodic memory transfer from the hippocampal one-shot notebook to the neocortical predictive student, why can standard consolidation overfit unpredictable details, and why must Go-CLS stop according to predictability?
